Espresso Brownies
=================
A compact interoperability fixture for tabular recipe rendering.
Yield: 16 squares
Prep: Butter and flour an 8 × 8 inch pan.
Prep: Preheat oven to 350 °F (170 °C).

INGREDIENTS
- 4 oz (115 g) unsalted butter
- 1 cup (200 g) sugar
- 1/4 tsp (2.5 mL) vanilla extract
- 1 shot (4 Tbsp; 60 mL) fresh brewed espresso or very strong coffee
- 2 large (100 g) eggs
- 1/2 cup (80 g) all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup (80 g) Hershey's cocoa powder
- 1/4 tsp (1.3 g) baking soda
- 1/4 tsp (1.5 g) table salt

FLOW
1. melt: unsalted butter -> melted butter
2. mix: melted butter + sugar + vanilla extract + fresh brewed espresso or very strong coffee -> coffee base
3. mix: coffee base + eggs -> wet batter
4. fold in: wet batter + all-purpose flour + Hershey's cocoa powder + baking soda + table salt -> batter
5. bake: batter -> brownies at 170 C for 30..40 min in 8 × 8 inch baking pan

Final: brownies
